name: File Backup Before Edit
description: Creates a .bak backup copy of files before Claude edits them
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Create backup of file before editing
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
if [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
  BACKUP_DIR="${HOME}/.claude/backups"
  mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"
  TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
  BASENAME=$(basename "$FILE")
  cp "$FILE" "${BACKUP_DIR}/${BASENAME}.${TIMESTAMP}.bak"
fi
exit 0
